notes: kind is permanent or day (24 hours). code is optional: without it the server picks one. Typed codes are cleaned up like at unlock (spaces, dashes, small letters). folder is the folder it sends into, and must be given (400 bad_request without). With shows_folder, guests with the PIN also see and download what is in the folder (but delete nothing); it is false unless given. Errors: pin_format (400), pin_taken (409): codes are never used twice; not_found (404) for no such folder. For a PIN that shows an encrypted folder, secret is what the PIN link's secret brings (the link is /#<code>.<secret>, the secret 32 random bytes in base64url): {"sealed": the secret sealed for version version of the folder's key, "version": …, "keys": [{"version", "locked": that version of the folder's key locked with the secret}]}; only with shows_folder (400 otherwise), 409 key_outdated for a version the folder doesn't have. A new code (/new-code) keeps the secret.
